crewNotes.text: Note: Bangladeshi passport holders may not import alcohol (seized); non-nationals may bring up to 1 litre. Crew should confirm any crew-specific treatment with the NBR. Compiled from the cited baggage rules, pending final authority review.

rules.text: Passengers who are not Bangladeshi nationals may bring in up to 1 litre of liquor duty-free. Bangladeshi passport holders may not carry any alcohol - it will be seized on arrival.
Up to 1 carton (200 cigarettes) for personal use; any excess is seized.

disclaimer: Verify current requirements with the relevant authority and airline procedures before travel.

sources.authorityName: Bangladesh Customs, National Board of Revenue (NBR)
